result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that mostly renders correctly, with a few minor layout issues related to content clipping at the edges.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge, with truncated text and image.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for horizontally scrollable carousels, but ensure the cut-off card provides a clear visual affordance that more content is scrollable to the right.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without an ellipsis, making it unclear the text is cut off versus part of a scrollable list.
issues.suggestion: Add ellipsis or ensure partial visibility clearly indicates scrollable content.

issues.description: The green promotional banner ('3 free deliveries for you') has white text on a light green background, which may have marginal contrast for the subtext.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast of the subtext to meet WCAG AA standards for readability.
